sources.snippet: NetSentinel AI NetSentinel AI is a modular Flask cybersecurity project for PCAP analysis, CICIDS2017-based machine learning, behavioural detection, threat intelligence enrichment, Gemini-assisted summaries, and PDF forensic reports.

sources.title: NetSentinel AI - Network Anomaly Detection + AI Explanation - GitHub
sources.snippet: NetSentinel AI - Network Anomaly Detection + AI Explanation An end-to-end Python project that detects anomalies in network traffic using an Isolation Forest model and explains suspicious logs using a Hugging Face LLM (zephyr-7b-beta).
